title: Seasonal events: Halloween and Christmas
player_outcome: Around Halloween (Oct 10 – Nov 1) and Christmas (Dec 15 – Dec 31) by the system date (with a settings toggle and a console override): pumpkins and jack-o'-lanterns, festive lights, NPCs wear seasonal hats, enemies drop goodie bags/presents, seasonal vanity and furniture, Santa can move in at Christmas.
design: Core: Season condition (date from an injectable clock, deterministic in tests) usable by spawn rules, loot, town rules, decorations; data for goodie bags/presents (bag loot tables), hats on NPCs (TownRenderer attachments), decorations as tile objects; seasonal music stinger optional.
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
